description: JAMESTOWN, NY - Senator George Borrello officially announced he is seeking re-election to the New York State Senate to represent the 57th District.“Representing my constituents in Western New York is a great privilege and one that I strive to honor by giving 110 percent every day. Albany is dominated by New York City legislators and activists whose priorities and values are a world apart from ours. I’ve made it my mission to be a champion for our district and rural New Yorkers,” said Senator Bor
